title: Modules
description: Switch modules on and off for your organisation. Data is not deleted when a module is switched off. You can always switch it on again.
adminOnly: Only owners and administrators can switch modules on and off.
none: No modules are configured for this organisation. Contact support to get access to modules.
locked: This module is not available to you. Contact support.

descriptions.projects: Enable project management. Without projects, time is only logged as general working time.
descriptions.reports: Access to reports and export of time data.
descriptions.clients: Enable the client register and the client field on projects and time entries.
descriptions.invoicing: Enable invoicing, recurring invoices and the billable flag.
descriptions.klippekort: Prepaid packages (blocks of prepaid hours) with balance tracking.
descriptions.integrations: Integrations with external accounting systems (Billy, Dinero, e-conomic).
descriptions.enterprise: Departments, employee profiles, flex balance, leave, absence, public holidays.
descriptions.public_api: API keys and programmatic access to your data.
descriptions.browser_extension: Browser extension for quick time tracking.
